EXAMPLE PACKAGE — FICTIONAL — NOT CUI

This archive is a synthetic test fixture for the SparkAE public reference
build (tests/own-file-stress.mjs). Every organisation, system, host, address,
person and identifier in it is invented for the test. "Harborline Example
Systems" and the "Lanternwick Ledger" system do not exist. Nothing here is a
real security package, and nothing here is Controlled Unclassified Information.
